description: Defines the FrameDecoderState class for decoding HTTP/2 frames, including state management, structure decoding, padding handling, and listener integration.

classes.name: FrameDecoderState
classes.description: Manages decoding state and behaviors for HTTP/2 frame headers and payloads, including padding, structure decoding, and listener callbacks.

methods.name: set_listener
methods.description: Sets the listener for frame decoding events.

methods.name: listener
methods.description: Returns the current frame decoder listener.

methods.name: frame_header
methods.description: Returns the most recently decoded frame header.

methods.name: StartDecodingStructureInPayload
methods.description: Decodes a structure within the payload, updating remaining payload size.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingStructureInPayload
methods.description: Resumes decoding a split structure within the payload.

methods.name: InitializeRemainders
methods.description: Initializes remaining payload and padding counters.

methods.name: remaining_total_payload
methods.description: Returns total remaining bytes including padding.

methods.name: remaining_payload
methods.description: Returns remaining payload bytes excluding padding.

methods.name: remaining_payload_and_padding
methods.description: Returns remaining payload plus padding bytes.

methods.name: AvailablePayload
methods.description: Returns how many payload bytes are available in the buffer.

methods.name: AvailablePayloadAndPadding
methods.description: Returns how many payload and padding bytes are available.

methods.name: AvailablePadding
methods.description: Returns how many padding bytes are available.

methods.name: ConsumePayload
methods.description: Reduces remaining payload by specified amount.

methods.name: ReadPadLength
methods.description: Reads and sets padding length from the payload.

methods.name: ReportFrameSizeError
methods.description: Reports a frame size error and returns decode error status.
